summary.text: Randy Hall is a Republican member of the Maine House of Representatives for House District 74, representing 12 towns and townships including Avon, Carthage, Industry.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Randy Hall's education as UNH (B.S. Agriculture, 1985).
The page lists Randy Hall's occupation as Farmer.
Listed affiliations include Fire Chief East Dixfield Fire Dept..
Randy Hall lives in Wilton and has served 4 sessions in the House, most recently the 132nd Legislature.
Family details on the page: married, spouse Lori, 3 children, 5 grandchildren.
